Name: Even More Dialogue - Elliott Outdated - 1.6 Compatible
Author: OSlySLy
Description:
[center][size=4][color=#ffff00]THIS MOD IS OUTDATED BUT WORKING FOR 1.6
May conflict with dialogue updates made by Concerned Ape.[/color]
[color=#ff0000](You may lose out on some 1.6+ dialogue if this mod is installed.)[/color]


Ever wanted to talk to a character in Stardew Valley and get even more dialogue responses?
Well here ya go.[/size]

[size=3]This mod makes Elliot a little more immersive, and makes him more of a gentleman over time.
[color=#00ff00](New dialogue will likely repeat, as it's mostly dependent on your current heart level, and less on specific days.
This helps with avoiding any prompted dialogue that could be seen as uncomfortable/out of character.)[/color]
Example: Elliott suddenly saying he wants to hold your hand, [i]when you're only at heart level 4 with him.[/i]
[/size]
[size=3][font=Tahoma][color=#ff7700]Features:[/color][/font]
-New dialogue to fill every day/heart level. (Unmarried)
-Added and revised dialogue when married.

[font=Tahoma][color=#ff7700][u]HOW TO INSTALL:[/u][/color][/font]
-Download the mod folder.
-Extract it, and place the unzipped folder in:
Program Files/steam/steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods.
-Start up Stardew Valley and you're done!

[font=Tahoma][color=#ff7700]Dialogue Not Showing?[/color][/font]
[spoiler]You may have another dialogue mod that overwrites this mod.
(Whichever mod loads last shows up in game.)
To fix, simply open the "manifest.json" file included in the mod folder with notepad,
then change the name on the second line: "Even More Dialogue - Elliott" to "Z Even More Dialogue - Elliott",
and then overwrite the .json file. This gives a mod more priority to be loaded last.
(Mods are loaded alphabetically for the most part.)[/spoiler]

[font=Tahoma][color=#ff0000]Other Info:[/color][/font]
[spoiler]*This is just one in a series of mods I've made out of boredom and curiosity for modding.
Expect mistakes/weird dialogue. [u]This is not a very optimized mod[/u].*
*This mod is pretty tame before marriage, but it does include a little suggestive dialogue after,
so I can't recommend it for any younger players. It will be tagged as Adult for this reason.*
[/spoiler]

[font=Tahoma][color=#00ff00]*Mod use intended for Vanilla Stardew Valley, not SVE.*
[/color][/font][color=#ffff00]*[b]Using this mod with other Elliott dialogue mods is not recommended, but doable.[/b]*
[b](It [/b][i][b]will[/b][/i][b] probably conflict and mix up his dialogue though.)
[/b][/color][/size][/center]
